verdict.rationale: The dedicated scrape endpoint is documented as turning a URL into "easily parseable text", not structured JSON. Structured output comes indirectly: enrichments fill named attribute columns using web scrapes, the API advertises extracting data from complicated websites, and quick_search returns structured url/title/snippet results. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that scrape responses are returned as structured JSON fields, a user-defined schema for scraped output, sample response payloads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
